jun: Heads-up — saw a new regression in kvcache behavior when running long-context PagedAttention workloads. Memory keeps creeping on H100 run, but MI250X shows a different failure mode (page remap churn).
maria: can you paste the minimal repro and perf numbers?
jun: repro: nightly/longctx/paged_attn/seq=16k batch=1 model=redwood-small variant=paged_kv. Command: `trainer --workload paged_attn --seq 16384 --batch 1 --runs 200`
jun: Observed: H100 run steadily grows GPU reserved memory ~90MB / 5min until OOM on run ~120. MI250X holds memory but paging IO, frequent pt remaps and vram<->host thrash.
sandeep: any kernel selection diffs? which attention kernel used?
jun: H100 picks `kv_paged_attn_v2_matmul_opt` for large seqs, MI250X falls back to `kv_paged_attn_generic` (no fused matmul). Both show increased page faults but pattern differs.
maria: got profiling traces? tail latency or throughput hit?
jun: profiler snapshot excerpt:
```
KVCache: page_evictions=3124 page_reclaims=2918 avg_eviction_latency_ms=2.8
PT: remap_ops=18432 remap_retries=128 remap_backoff_ms=10
Runtime: 99p_token_latency +31% vs baseline
```
ryan: interesting — remap_retries suggest ordering/race in pt-owner flip. Could be our pt shadow map not synced with GPU DMA ordering on NVLink.
jun: I captured strace on user-space and PCIe stall counters. Logs show frequent `PCIe TLP replay` entries around the time of remaps.
sandeep: could be our p2p/unified allocator path: on H100 we do contiguous allocations, on MI250X allocator fragments and causes scatter when spilling, so pagewalk paths differ.
maria: also noticed `kvcache::reuse_window` metric decreasing before the spike, meaning reuse locality degenerates. That would increase eviction churn.
jun: Repro snippet in debug mode (KV_DEBUG=1) gives this stack around eviction:
```
[evict] owner=0x7f12a3b4 page_id=0x1a2c flags=0x4
[pt] remap start idx=0x1a2c -> phys=0x3ffab, fallback=1
[rt] dma_submit returned EAGAIN, retrying
```
ryan: EAGAIN from dma_submit on H100 might be due to our async-completion queue depth being too low for the bigger kernel. That would increase remap_retries and cause backpressure.
sandeep: can you rerun with INFLIGHT_DMA=2048 and `KV_CACHE_RECLAIM_BATCH=64`? If it's an ordering hole we might see repro change.
jun: running now on H100. ETA ~15m. Will post logs.
infra-bot: new ephemeral job started: build/longctx-h100-3712345678 (links: https://ci.internal/jobs/3712345678).
maria: also try toggling `KV_PAGETABLE_STRICT=1` (will add extra syncs) to see if this fixes correctness at perf cost. If it stabilizes memory growth it points to missing fences.
ryan: if fences help, we should consider selective fence insertion around pt remap + dma submit only for the kernel path that uses `matmul_opt`. Otherwise we'd pay too much overhead.
sandeep: note: MI250X's different fallback kernel could be hiding the fence bug because it uses smaller DMA ops.
jun: quick log from H100 run after bumping INFLIGHT_DMA:
```
KVCache: page_evictions=128 page_reclaims=120 avg_eviction_latency_ms=4.1
PT: remap_ops=4200 remap_retries=3 remap_backoff_ms=0
Runtime: 99p_token_latency +12% vs baseline
```
jun: growth slowed but latency increased. So inflight bump reduced retries but higher latency from larger queue handling.
maria: that triangulates the issue: race/order between remap and dma completion.
ryan: next steps: (1) instrument DMA completion ordering + add optional barrier before PT flip to confirm, (2) add small unit test that forces remap+concurrent-dma interleaving, (3) run hardware perf counters for PCIe replay on H100 to correlate.
sandeep: I'll draft a tiny PR for an opt-in `KV_PAGETABLE_FENCE_MODE=lite` that inserts a lightweight memory barrier and tracks perf. If that helps, we can toggle on Dedicated or Dedicated+Private customers until we find micro-optimizations.
jun: assigning to @sandeep for PR, @ryan for perf counters, I will continue runs and collect traces.
maria: nice work. If this turns into a regression vs last release we should prepare a rollback plan for the matmul fusion path. :warning:
ryan: +1 for rollback plan. Also add a prometheus metric for remap_retries so we can alert.
infra-bot: job build/longctx-h100-3712345678 finished: SUCCESS (artifacts at https://ci.internal/artifacts/3712345678).
jun: uploaded KV debug logs and perf traces to the thread. Will share S3 link in a bit.
maria: thanks — let's sync at 11:30 to decide whether to gate matmul_opt rollout. :calendar:
